lines.text: Posted Readout · Day 7 · test_1 · v1: Continue: Cost per result was 10.12 against a target of 16.0 (0.632 of target) so it does not meet the stop rule of >1.2x target, but with 13.0 results it also does not yet meet the scale rule requiring cost <=0.85x target and results >=30 [ev-d7-test_1-readout].

Last week was quiet with nothing to act on through Day 6 and 1 item to act on by Day 7. Test 1 ran 7.0 days and delivered 13.0 results on 131.54 spend with cost per result of 10.12 compared to target of 16.0 [ev-d7-test_1-readout]. Cost was 0.632 of target so it did not meet the stop condition of cost >1.2x target, but results are below the 30 needed to scale [ev-d7-test_1-readout].

No evidence in the inputs is labeled for test w1-t2 (Fountain Reset - Clean in a Snap) [ev-w1-ad_1-week, ev-w1-ad_2-week, ev-w1-ad_4-week, ev-w1-ad_5-week, ev-d7-test_1-readout]. The closest available numbers are cost_per_result 11.57 [ev-w1-ad_1-week], cost_per_result 21.99 [ev-w1-ad_2-week], cost_per_result 10.09 [ev-w1-ad_4-week], and cost_per_result 10.12 [ev-w1-ad_5-week] with cost_per_result 10.12 and target_cost_per_result 16.0 [ev-d7-test_1-readout], and none of the provided evidence includes product price numbers.

The provided evidence does not include a verified product price for the Gentle Steering Harness [ev-d7-test_1-readout][ev-w1-ad_5-week]. The verified numbers you can use are a target cost per result of 16.0 and prior test performance of 13.0 results at 10.12 cost per result on 131.54 spend [ev-d7-test_1-readout][ev-w1-ad_5-week].

The provided evidence does not include product feature details, so I cannot confirm quick-release buckles and adjustable straps for the harness [ev-d7-test_1-readout][ev-w1-ad_1-week][ev-w1-ad_2-week][ev-w1-ad_4-week][ev-w1-ad_5-week].

The inputs show cost_per_result of 10.12 versus target_cost_per_result of 16.0 [ev-d7-test_1-readout] and weekly cost_per_result values of 11.57 [ev-w1-ad_1-week], 21.99 [ev-w1-ad_2-week], 10.09 [ev-w1-ad_4-week] and 10.12 [ev-w1-ad_5-week].
